title: Probe route B: the owner's own small site that holds a GitHub token
why: Owner ruling R28 (one store for page data, git first) and owner 12:10 CST: "Custom connectors are not allowed -- so we can do route B".
source: coordinator 12:28 CST Nov 12, from lane page-data-one-store (decision waiting-page-one-store rewritten to route B on #2829, owner 12:10 CST)
note: Owner-yes acts, each its own yes when the step starts: the Cloudflare account (the owner has one: decision github-apps-keep-access says Cloudflare serves joyous through its worker), a GitHub token mint, a test deploy and an access gate. No custom domain or paid plan. The lane holds until the coordinator starts it. Owner 12:29 CST Nov 12: "use my existing cloudflare setup that should be saved i believe -- or we can use neon/render too if that's useful". A token in the page is ruled out (step prose-tending-contract, owner 11:55 CST: a token never goes in a page; a server holds it). The probe measures the server only: the owner's Cloudflare Worker first (no Cloudflare creds in the cloud env, checked 12:29 CST), Render as fallback (RENDER_API_KEY is in the cloud env). No deploy or token mint in the probe. Lane started 12:30 CST.
